Smoke test: XLSX with basic spreadsheet data including tables

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().metadata)
}
```
